title: Universal Intelligence Evolution and Relay Unit (UIERU): Composable Intelligence Organization, Forward Guidance, Structural Relay, and Validated Evolution
description: UIERU proposes a composable organizational architecture for coordinating human, AI, agent, model, and service capabilities through a canonical unit U = (K, P, F, R, E): contract, calling path, scoring forest, structural relay, and evolution. The research develops forward-guided execution, multi-trail sandbox exploration, counter-evidence preservation, contract-aware composition, bidirectional collective learning, and independently validated structural recursive self-improvement. Extensions investigate subject-indexed world models and structural memory, large-scale AI platform organization, and subject sovereignty in collective intelligence ecosystems. The repository contains research papers, cases, engineering specifications, figures, and an explicit empirical validation agenda. Architectural proposals and hypotheses are not presented as experimentally established performance improvements.
keywords: Universal Intelligence Evolution and Relay Unit
